fact: On 17 December 2025 the Dschang council delivered its first computerised birth certificates, with data entered into the SIGEC platform run by BUNEC; Garoua II (28 March 2025) and Nitoukou (14 March 2025) had done so earlier in the year.
title: Cameroun : La commune de Dschang délivre ses premiers actes de naissance informatisés
